reading: The elementary representation used for the prime references is the generalized q-Weyl algebra with P(y) = 1 + y. Its space of twisted traces is one dimensional, so the algebra's own invariant pairing carries no arithmetic parameter at all. Every prime parameter in Section 6 enters through the chosen dressing state, which Section 6.5 shows is unconstrained. The twisted-trace classification therefore bounds what one copy of the algebra can do and says nothing about the Bloch lift, which uses infinitely many orthogonal copies.
scope: An identification of the algebra and its consequence under two quoted theorems. No positivity statement, no claim about the physical adjoints, and no reproof of the quoted theorems.
